images.why: Scientific 3D fallback: entry 5WSN identifies mature Japanese encephalitis virus reconstructed by cryo-EM at 4.30 Å. Coloured whole-particle rendering suitable for a near-square crop. Pixel dimensions and direct-file download could not be verified; no qualifying colourised TEM was found. The entry page does not state an image-specific licence.
